commands.name: init
commands.summary: Creates the workspace in the current folder, and refuses inside an existing one.

commands.name: new
commands.summary: Adds a product folder from the type's starter skeleton at version 1.0.0.

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Downloads an export_product bundle_url itself (or reads a file, or - for standard input), unpacks it into its type folder or refreshes an existing folder (--force over local changes), and commits it.

commands.name: dev
commands.summary: Starts the Rafflex app on this workspace: products, previews, tests, and prompts, with live updates. Outside a workspace it sets one up in a new rafflex folder first.

commands.name: format
commands.summary: Formats the template in the house style, never touching Twig. --check reports without writing.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Runs the platform's rules, the lint warnings, and a format check on the named products, or on every product with --all.

commands.name: test
commands.summary: Plays every scenario in headless Chromium at phone, tablet, and desktop widths, plays games through, and runs the specs in tests/. Needs Playwright (test --install).

commands.name: capture
commands.summary: Writes a cover image and screenshots into the product's listing/ folder from the browser run when it has none, and never overwrites the creator's own unless --force is given. Without Playwright it skips and exits 0.

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Runs format, then check, then test when Playwright is installed. Run it before every push and fix every blocking issue.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Shows each product's local and live versions, review state, and what changed since the last push.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Runs verify, then lists as data exactly what push would send: template, options, listing, assets, listing images, and release notes. Not ready while verify has blocking issues.

commands.name: push
commands.summary: Pushes what the plan says changed through a request_sync link (template, options, listing, version, release notes, new files, libraries, the cover and screenshots), creates the product on its first push and renames its folder to the slug, records the result, and commits it as a Push. Refused while verify blocks or when the draft changed on the marketplace since the last sync.

commands.name: synced
commands.summary: Records the product's remote state and feedback from a request_sync link (or a get_product result on standard input, only when push cannot reach the marketplace). Commits a Push or Sync when the draft changed, product.json alone when only other state changed, and nothing when nothing changed.

commands.name: release
commands.summary: Run only after submit_for_review succeeds: closes the Unreleased changelog section (refused without notes there), marks the version in review, commits, and tags it. With a request_sync link it records the fresh state too, and refuses with not_submitted, changing nothing, before the version is submitted.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Sets the next version, and is refused while the current version is in review.

commands.name: restore
commands.summary: Returns a product folder to its last confirmed push, discarding unpushed work (needs --yes). Reverting a shipped version is revert_to_version on the marketplace.
